wcag_aa_requirements: All body text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast against surface background.
Headings and primary CTA buttons meet minimum 3:1 contrast ratio.
Interactive touch targets are minimum 44px by 44px on coarse pointers.
Interactive states do not rely on color alone (include icons, borders, or underline indicators).
testing_data_testids: Every interactive element (buttons, links, inputs, selects, toggles) MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Convention: kebab-case role-based naming e.g., data-testid='dashboard-topup-button', data-testid='number-search-input'.
